entries.purpose: The bundled typeface used for every generated card and cover image.
entries.consumer: src/publishing/image_pipeline.py:616-617 -> the research, visibility and manual image paths
entries.evidence: image_pipeline.py loads the bundled Inter rather than a system font so output is deterministic across runners.

entries.purpose: The SIL Open Font License covering Inter-Variable.ttf.
entries.consumer: No code. It is the licence obligation that accompanies the tracked font.
entries.evidence: Distributing the font requires distributing this licence. .gitignore:28 records that the logo and fonts must not be ignored.
entries.action: none - a licence file with no code consumer is not an orphan. Recorded explicitly so a future dead-artifact sweep does not remove it.

entries.purpose: The brand logo overlaid on generated images.
entries.evidence: image_pipeline.py:1309 records that the logo is overlaid from LOGO_PATH and never drawn by the image model. scripts/test_publishers.py:1050 checks it exists before a Cloudinary upload.
